findings.claim: Only recognized choice arguments enter Pi; unknown flags and non-choice calls stay on CLI.
Provider arg is ignored and Pi is fixed to openrouter/typesafe/jev-1.13, creating a silent semantic switch risk.
Current result validation requires in-set choice and finite probability per key but omits range, sum, and argmax consistency checks.
Pi failures fall back to CLI after one timed classify attempt, which may increase total latency/cost.
Three option rotations account for 333 Pi calls across 111 benchmark rows; scout screening can use fewer calls before confirmatory rotations.
Six additional source-verified choice call sites are conditional reuse candidates; current imports remain two.
Question types outside choice must stay on CLI pending dedicated schema and measurement.
Feature 038's direct-spawn inventory conflicts internally at 21 versus 20; its 13-row table is not an exhaustive census.
